notes.title: Update Notes for May 16
notes.content:
An update has been pushed to Steam with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Several menus have been redesigned
[*] The shop can now be accessed from the lobby screen
[*] The settings menu can now be accessed from in-game, via the pause menu
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the pause menu to immediately disappear after opening
[/list]
Please note that in order to play with your friends, you will each need to update to the same version of the game. You can force an update by relaunching the Steam client.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 20
notes.content:
An update has been pushed to Steam with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Renamed bot characters
[*] Slightly zoomed out the camera to make it easier to see incoming projectiles
[*] Increased the size of the map by 25%
[*] Added a cooldown timer to prevent a certain rare event from recurring too frequently
[*] Balance changes:
[list]
[*] Sawed-off: increased number of pellets from 5 to 7
[*] Beam shotgun: increased number of beams from 3 to 4
[*] Beam pistol: increased rate of fire, reduced ammo capacity from 10 to 8
[/list][*] Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when joining an existing match
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when accepting an invitation to match you are already in
[/list][/list]
Please note that in order to play with your friends, you will each need to update to the same version of the game. You can force an update by relaunching the Steam client.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 18
notes.content:
An update has been pushed to Steam with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added the option to disable bots if two or more players are present in the lobby
[*] Increased the number of treasure chests that may appear at one time
[*] Made treasure chests more likely to appear close to the centre of the map
[/list]

Please note that in order to play with your friends, you will each need to update to the same version of the game. You can force an update by relaunching the Steam client.

notes.title: KILL YOUR FRIENDS is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
KILL YOUR FRIENDS is a multiplayer online arena shooter for up to 6 players. Kill your friends, or strangers, or AI using a variety of guns & explosives! Collect coins to add to your stash - the player with the most coins at the end of the match wins!

[list]
[*] KILL YOUR FRIENDS with 17 powerful weapons, from the beam rifle to the grenade shotgun 🔫
[*] Jet off to 5 unique environments to do battle 🛫
[*] Stash away the coins you've earned at the end of each match 💰
[*] Spend your hard-earned coins in the shop to unlock 35 hats and custom grave markers for your character 🎩
[*] Unlock 16 challenging achievements 🏆
[/list]

Available now with a special launch discount of -15%!

notes.title: KILL YOUR FRIENDS Demo Stream
notes.content:
Hi there! I'm the developer of KILL YOUR FRIENDS.
I will be streaming the KYF Demo for an hour, and answering any questions you might have.
Hope to see you in chat!

You can try the demo yourself, for free, throughout Steam Next Fest!
(Ends June 22nd @ 10AM Pacific)

[h2]About the game[/h2]

KILL YOUR FRIENDS is a multiplayer online arena shooter for up to 6 players. Kill your friends, or strangers, or AI using a variety of guns & explosives! Collect coins to add to your stash - the player with the most coins at the end of the match wins!

This is an early preview of KILL YOUR FRIENDS, featuring 3 procedurally generated environments, 6 character outfits, and 7 weapons.

[h2]Future content[/h2]

Planned future features include:

[list]
[*] Several additional weapons, including a flamethrower, a flak cannon, and guns that shoot bouncy bullets 🔫
[*] More environments to explore 🛫
[*] The ability to stash away the coins you've earned at the end of each match 💰
[*] The chance to earn a crown every time you win a match 👑
[*] An in-game store where you can spend your hard-earned coins & crowns on hats 🎩 & custom grave markers 👻 for your character
[*] Achievements (which grant exclusive cosmetic rewards 🥳)
[/list]
